body: we named this whole thing after "long live" -- the song taylor's called "the first love song that i've written to my team." not to a person; a thank-you to the band and crew, born backstage on the last night of the fearless tour in 2010. it closed the speak now tour and keeps coming back, all the way to eras. long live.
